name: Skipper Limited
summary: Skipper Limited manufactures and sells transmission and distribution structures, telecom towers, and fasteners in India. The company operates through three segments: Engineering Products, Infrastructure Projects, and Polymer Products. The Engineering Products segment offers power transmission towers, telecom towers, tower accessories, fasteners, angles, channels, high mast and swaged poles, solar power systems, railway structures, as well as power distribution poles, transmission lines, monopoles, mild steel and high tensile angles, and other products.
